chosen_args.why_stop: S1 satisfied: candidate_13 is a feasible optimized lowest-cost candidate in the full admissible window. S2 satisfied: every candidate was optimized, with 3 feasible and 12 infeasible under the 90 m3 bed cap. S3 satisfied: the highest-atomic-activity candidate candidate_04 differs from the industrial winner; its required intrinsic-activity multiplier for cost parity is 201.22x and TEST_REACHABILITY classifies this as unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold. Additional affordable actions have low expected industrial-decision value because they would only add sensitivity or reduce MC sampling noise, not alter the canonical frozen-descriptor optimum.

unresolved_decision_risk.primary: Descriptor uncertainty: in a 300-draw MC over the feasible optimized candidates, candidate_13 is lowest cost in 72.33% of draws and candidate_04 in 27.67%; candidate_13 feasibility under descriptor uncertainty is 81%. This affects robustness confidence, not the frozen canonical decision.
unresolved_decision_risk.model_edges: candidate_13 optimum uses the allowed Tsep upper edge, while candidate_04 and candidate_05 use the T upper edge; within the declared process window these are valid optima, but extrapolating outside the window was not attempted.
unresolved_decision_risk.unmodeled_candidates: All deterministic candidates were optimized.
